transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. I work at a warehouse, and lately... I don't know, every little noise just pulls me completely off my count. A beeper goes off, or a forklift alarm sounds, or even just someone moving a pallet nearby, and my attention is gone. Then I look down and realize I've put the wrong numbers into the inventory system. It's starting to become a real problem for me at work.
Roughly how long have you been experiencing these difficulties with your focus?

It's been going on for about a month now. Uh, right around the time my husband stopped working outside the home. Our usual routine changed up a lot when that happened, and... yeah, it's been about a month of me struggling with this.
Over the past month, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, I haven't felt like that. I mean, I'm a little frustrated about messing up my counts at work, but... no, I haven't been feeling sad or depressed or anything. I definitely don't feel hopeless. It's really just the distraction that's bothering me.
Aside from feeling frustrated, have you been feeling unusually anxious, nervous, or on edge lately?

No, I haven't really felt anxious or nervous. I mean, maybe a little stressed right at the moment I realize I messed up a count, but... no, I don't feel on edge in general. It really is just the distraction that's the issue.
Have you been experiencing unusual mental exhaustion or physical fatigue, especially after doing routine tasks?

No, not really. I mean, I get tired after a long shift at work, but that's pretty normal for me. I haven't noticed any unusual exhaustion or feeling wiped out after just doing regular stuff. I've got my normal amount of energy.
Have you had any head injuries, concussions, or serious medical illnesses recently?
No, nothing like that. I haven't hit my head or been sick or anything. I've been perfectly healthy, physically anyway.
